posYmenu = 101;
posXmenu = 0;
bgcolor='#08518C';
bgcolor2='#FF6100';
bgcolor3='#1F7AB9';
var TimeoutID=0;
var dofusSite = "http://www.dofus.com";
var dofusSite2 = "http://jouer.dofus.com";

zlien = new Array;

zlien[0] = new Array;

zlien[1] = new Array;
addlien(1,0, dofusSite  + "/lejeu/presentation.asp","Présentation du jeu");
addlien(1,1, dofusSite  + "/actualite/carnet_bord.asp","Carnet de bord");
addlien(1,2, dofusSite  + "/actualite/concours.asp","Concours/Sondage");
addlien(1,3, dofusSite  + "/sinscrire/newsletter.asp","Inscription newsletter");
addlien(1,4, dofusSite2  + "/sinscrire/betatest.php","Inscription bêta-tests");
	
zlien[2] = new Array;
addlien(2,0, dofusSite  + "/lejeu/histoire.asp","L'histoire");
addlien(2,1, dofusSite  + "/univers/guildes.asp","Les guildes");
addlien(2,2, dofusSite  + "/univers/monde.asp","Le monde");
addlien(2,3, dofusSite  + "/univers/bestiaire.asp","Le bestiaire");
addlien(2,4, dofusSite  + "/univers/population.asp","La population");

zlien[3] = new Array;

zlien[4] = new Array;
addlien(4,0, dofusSite  + "/bonus/screenshots.asp","Screenshots");
addlien(4,1, dofusSite  + "/bonus/fondecran.asp","Fonds d'écran");
addlien(4,2, dofusSite  + "/bonus/animation.asp","Animations");
addlien(4,3, dofusSite  + "/bonus/figurines.asp","Figurines");
addlien(4,4, dofusSite  + "/bonus/irc.asp","Chat IRC");

//addlien(0,2, dofusSite  + "/lejeu/demo.asp","La démo");

var nava = (document.layers);
var dom = (document.getElementById);
var iex = (document.all);
if (nava) { skn = document.topdeck }
else if (dom) { skn = document.getElementById("topdeck").style }
else if (iex) { skn = topdeck.style }
skn.top = posYmenu+22;


function mOvr(src,clrOver){
	clearTimeout(TimeoutID);
	src.style.cursor = 'hand';
	src.bgColor = clrOver;
}
function mOut(src,clrIn){
	src.style.cursor = 'default';
	src.bgColor = clrIn;
	TimeoutID=setTimeout("kill()", 500);
}
function pop(msg,pos)
{
skn.visibility = "hidden";
a=true
skn.left = posXmenu+pos;
var content ="<TABLE BORDER=0 CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 WIDTH=150><TR><TD><TABLE WIDTH=100% BORDER=0 CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=1>";
pass = 0
while (pass < msg.length)
{
	content += "<TR><TD BGCOLOR="+bgcolor2+" onMouseOver=\"javascript:mOvr(this, '"+bgcolor3+"');\" onMouseOut=\"javascript:mOut(this, '"+bgcolor2+"');\" HEIGHT=19 onClick=\"location.href='"+msg[pass][1]+"'\"><B>&nbsp;&nbsp;"+msg[pass][0]+"&nbsp;&nbsp;</B></TD></TR>";
	pass++;
}
content += "</TABLE></TD></TR></TABLE>";
if (nava)
  {
    skn.document.write(content);
	  skn.document.close();
	  skn.visibility = "visible";
  }
    else if (dom)
  {
	  document.getElementById("topdeck").innerHTML = content;
	  skn.visibility = "visible";
  }
    else if (iex)
  {
	  document.all("topdeck").innerHTML = content;
	  skn.visibility = "visible";
  }
}
function kill()
{
	skn.visibility = "hidden";
}
function addlien(i, j, l, t)
{
zlien[i][j] = ['<A HREF="'+l+'" CLASS=ejsmenu>'+t+'</A>', l];
}

document.onclick = kill;
